title: simple days at a cottage by the sea
en: i visited the town of squim last week during the annual lavender festival it seems like the entire town exploded into shades of purple and green overnight the smell was everywhere even while driving i could detect it and it led me to this quaint little farm just outside of town do
i also got the chance to spend a day at

an adorable little cottage by the sea my boyfriend and i made a single exception of staying at a family home to enjoy our first ever bnb it felt appropriate to do something a bit fancy as a treat to celebrate two years of knowing each other we're not often travelers and it was so exciting the biggest struggle i faced during this trip was actually disconnecting from my work life i find that very difficult to do and it was a wonderful challenge to truly embrace the days i can't remember the last time i had a proper vacation planned out like this of course i still filmed and did what was necessary to keep my business running but for the most part i had a lot more time off than usual

it was so lovely to take joy in soaking in the sights and sounds of a new place the luscious greens of the landscape made me miss springtime at home and look forward to the autumn reigns it's so easy to get caught up in work especially when you enjoy your job or have big goals for the future a current dream of mine is to be a homeowner in my mind's eye i've always imagined having a family and living in a small cabin by the river or nestled deep in a forest but i find that the quickest way to turn a dream into something stressful is by setting a strict timeline to its achievement if i do that it inevitably becomes a sort of race where my body exists in the present but my mind lives in the future

imagining a life i don't have while letting the one i do pass me by i find this mentality can negatively affect everything in life for example i've always been a dreamer and someone with a vivid imagination and yet it is important to not let that blind you from appreciating the tactile world the people in your life your real relationships these things solely existing in the present at this very moment have so much value and if i've learned anything this summer it's that your life can change in the blink of an eye you may very well lose something important when you least expect it that is the beautiful and complex and

heart-wrenching reality you cannot control the future but right now at this moment you can choose to love and there's no better way to use your time as i enjoy the last days of my trip and prepare to head home i realized that even though i've loved this vacation it also made me aware of how much i truly feel tied to my valley even with everything that's going on and what it's facing right now i want to be there and to do what i can to protect it it's a cathartic moment when you realize you've truly found home
i hope you all have a wonderful day or night i'm sending you my love and i will see you next week you
zh: 上周我在一年一度的薰衣草节期间参观了斯奎姆镇，似乎整个小镇一夜之间变成了紫色和绿色的阴影，即使在开车时我也能闻到这种气味，它把我带到了镇外的这个古色古香的小农场。

海边的一栋可爱的小小屋，我和男朋友破例住在家庭住宅里，享受我们有史以来的第一个民宿，感觉很适合做一些有点奇特的事情来庆祝我们认识两年了，我们不经常旅行，这太令人兴奋了，我在这次旅行中遇到的最大的困难实际上是与我的工作生活脱节，我发现这很难做到，这是一个很棒的挑战，要真正拥抱那些日子，我不记得上次我有一个像这样计划的适当的假期是什么时候，当然我还在拍摄并做了必要的事情来维持我的业务运转，但大多数情况下我的休息时间比平常多得多
沉浸在新地方的景色和声音中真是太可爱了，甘美的绿色风景让我怀念家里的春天，期待秋天的统治，很容易陷入工作，尤其是当你喜欢你的工作或对未来有远大的目标时，我目前的梦想是成为我心目中的房主，我一直想象有一个家庭，住在河边的小木屋里或坐落在森林深处，但我发现将梦想变成有压力的事情的最快方法是为它的实现设定严格的时间表，如果我这样做，它不可避免地会变成一种竞赛，我的身体存在于现在，但我的思想生活在未来
想象一种我没有的生活，而让我所拥有的生活与我擦肩而过，我发现这种心态会对生活中的一切产生负面影响，例如，我一直是一个梦想家和一个拥有生动想象力的人，但重要的是不要让这种心态蒙蔽你，让你无法欣赏触觉世界，你生活中的人，你真正的关系，这些仅存在于当下的事物具有如此多的价值，如果我今年夏天学到了什么，那就是你的生活可能会在眨眼间改变当你最意想不到的时候，很可能会失去一些重要的东西，那就是美丽、复杂和
令人心碎的现实，你无法控制未来，但现在，你可以选择去爱，没有更好的方式来利用你的时间，因为我享受旅行的最后几天，准备回家，我意识到，尽管我很喜欢这个假期，但它也让我意识到，即使正在发生的一切和它现在面临的情况，我也真正感受到与我的山谷的联系，我想在那里，尽我所能来保护它，当你意识到你已经真正找到家
我希望你们度过愉快的一天或一夜，我向你们致以我的爱，下周再见
